newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Orbital accounting change makes loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Orbital accounting change makes loss.

text.p: Engine designer Orbital Engine Corp Ltd said on Thursday the losses for the year to June 30, 1996 were due to changes in accounting treatments that mainly reflect the current stage of group's engine commercialisation.
Orbital, about 25 percent owned by The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, said it plans to eliminate all intangible items from its balance sheet by the end of the 1999 financial year.
Orbital earlier reported an operating loss of A$25.54 million for 1995/96 against a loss A$3.95 million in 1994/95.

Orbital said it was no longer capitalising any of its pre-production expenditure and start-up costs. It also started amortisation of capitalised pre-production expenditure and patents, which resulted in a A$19.95 million abnormal loss.

Orbital also expensed A$29.20 million representing certain previously capitalised pre-production expenditure and all costs associated with its manufacturing operations at Tecumseh, Michigan. It said these two items were the bulk of the A$62.11 million abnormal loss in 1995/96. Orbital shares closed one cent lower at 96 cents on Thursday.
